links.comparator_used: Original retrospective validation results (AUC 0.75-0.81, AUPRC 0.19-0.38) from the model's earlier development and validation study
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC, AUPRC) and Brier score when the model ran silently in the live EHR for one year, compared with the original retrospective validations
links.effect: Average AUC 0.78 (SD 0.02) vs 0.75-0.81 in original validations; AUPRC 0.41 (SD 0.04) vs 0.19-0.38 previously; Brier score 0.10 (SD 0.01); no SPC control violations over 12 months
links.tradeoff: Some input and population data were not retained by the EPIC Nebula module, which limited cohort characterisation. The follow-up was only one year.
links.quote: The average AUC (0.78) during this follow-up is comparable to the original validations (AUCs ranging between 0.75 and 0.81), while the AUPRC (0.41) even is slightly higher (previous AUPRCs ranging between 0.19 and 0.38).

design_hint: drift monitoring with statistical process control charts
